"content": "import pypsa
import pandas as pd

snapshots = pd.date_range(\"2024-01-01\", periods=168, freq=\"h\")
network = pypsa.Network()
network.set_snapshots(snapshots)

# Buses
buses_df = pd.read_csv(\"data/buses.csv\", index_col=\"name\")
network.import_components_from_dataframe(buses_df, \"Bus\")

# Lines
lines_df = pd.read_csv(\"data/links.csv\")
lines_df[\"name\"] = lines_df[\"bus0\"].astype(str) + \"-\" + lines_df[\"bus1\"].astype(str)
lines_df[\"s_nom\"] = lines_df[\"p_nom\"]
lines_df[\"r\"] = lines_df[\"length\"] * 0.0032
lines_df[\"x\"] = lines_df[\"length\"] * 0.32
lines_df = lines_df[[\"name\", \"bus0\", \"bus1\", \"s_nom\", \"r\", \"x\"]]
network.import_components_from_dataframe(lines_df.set_index(\"name\"), \"Line\")

# Generators
gens_df = pd.read_csv(\"data/generators.csv\")
gens_df[\"name\"] = gens_df[\"bus\"].astype(str) + \"-\" + gens_df[\"carrier\"].str.replace(\" \", \"_\")
gens_df = gens_df.set_index(\"name\")[[\"bus\", \"p_nom\", \"marginal_cost\", \"carrier\"]]
network.import_components_from_dataframe(gens_df, \"Generator\")

# Loads
bus_list = list(network.buses.index)
load_names = [f\"load-{b}\" for b in bus_list]
load_df = pd.DataFrame({\"bus\": bus_list}, index=load_names)
network.import_components_from_dataframe(load_df, \"Load\")
demand_df = pd.read_csv(\"data/demand.csv\")
demand_df.columns = load_names
network.loads_t.p_set = demand_df

# Wind
wind_cf_df = pd.read_csv(\"data/wind_cf.csv\")
wind_gens = network.generators[network.generators.carrier == \"onshore_wind\"].index
p_max_pu_dict = {g: wind_cf_df[g.split(\"-\")[0]] for g in wind_gens}
network.generators_t.p_max_pu[wind_gens] = pd.DataFrame(p_max_pu_dict, index=snapshots)

# Storage
sto_df = pd.read_csv(\"data/storage.csv\")
sto_df[\"name\"] = sto_df[\"bus\"].astype(str) + \"-\" + sto_df[\"carrier\"]
sto_df = sto_df.set_index(\"name\")
sto_df[\"max_p_hours\"] = sto_df[\"e_nom\"] / sto_df[\"p_nom\"]
sto_df[\"efficiency_store\"] = sto_df[\"efficiency\"]
sto_df[\"efficiency_dispatch\"] = sto_df[\"efficiency\"]
sto_df[\"marginal_cost\"] = 0.0
sto_df = sto_df[[\"bus\", \"p_nom\", \"max_p_hours\", \"efficiency_store\", \"efficiency_dispatch\", \"marginal_cost\"]]
network.import_components_from_dataframe(sto_df, \"StorageUnit\")

network.consistency_check()
network.export_to_netcdf(\"outputs/network_baseline_fixed.nc\")
print(\"Fixed network exported\")

import pypsa
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
n = pypsa.Network("outputs/network_baseline.nc")
n.optimize(solver_name="highs")
print("Optimized")

# Network map
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,8))
n.plot(ax=ax, bus_size=0, line_widths=n.lines.s_nom/100, line_colors='r')
plt.title("GB Power Network (20 nodes)")
plt.savefig("report/images/network_map.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

# Gen capacity by type
gen_cap = n.generators.groupby('carrier').p_nom.sum()
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
gen_cap.plot(kind='pie', ax=ax, autopct='%1.1f%%')
ax.set_ylabel('')
plt.title("Generation Capacity by Type")
plt.savefig("report/images/gen_cap_pie.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()

# Gas dispatch heatmap (example)
gas_gens = n.generators[n.generators.carrier == 'gas'].index
if len(gas_gens) > 0:
    gas_p = n.generators_t.p[gas_gens].mean(axis=1).unstack(level=0).fillna(0)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12,6))
    sns.heatmap(gas_p.T, cmap='YlOrRd', ax=ax)
    ax.set_title("Average Gas Generation per Bus (MW)")
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.savefig("report/images/gas_dispatch_heatmap.png", dpi=150)
    plt.close()

# Line loading max
line_load = (n.lines_t.p0.abs() / n.lines.s_nom).max(axis=1)
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
line_load.sort_values(ascending=False).plot(kind='bar', ax=ax)
ax.set_title("Max Line Loading")
ax.set_ylabel("Loading p.u.")
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("report/images/line_loading.png", dpi=150)
plt.close()

# Curtailment
wind_gens = n.generators[n.generators.carrier.str.contains('wind', na=False)].index
p_avail = n.generators_t.p_max_pu[wind_gens] * n.generators.loc[wind_gens, 'p_nom']
curt = (p_avail - n.generators_t.p[wind_gens]).clip(lower=0).sum(axis=1)
fig, ax = plt.subplots()
curt.plot(ax=ax, label='Curtailment')
ax.set_ylabel('MW')
ax.set_title('Wind Curtailment Timeseries')
plt.savefig("report/images/curtail_timeseries.png", dpi=150)
plt.close()

print("Figures saved")

"

We modeled the GB power system using PyPSA (v0.35.2), an open-source toolbox for power system analysis. The model represents a 20-node 400 kV network with 23 transmission lines (capacities 1500-5000 MW), generators (onshore wind ~10 GW at select buses, gas ~0.4-0.8 GW/bus, nuclear 1.2 GW x3), 3 PHS storage units (200-300 MW power, 1200-1800 MWh energy, 75% eff), and hourly demand/wind CF over 1 week (168 snapshots).
- **Network**: DC linear optimal power flow (LOPF) with N-0 security.
- **Objective**: Minimize system costs (marginal costs: wind=0, nuclear=10 €/MWh, gas=50 €/MWh).
